hook: None of these can run the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash quant we read
items: Flagship phone: No, the quant we read is 359 GB
Laptop, 8 GB, no GPU: No, it asks for 80 GiB RAM
MacBook Air, 16 GB: No, it asks for 80 GiB RAM
RTX 4060, 8 GB: No, it asks for a 32 GB GPU
RTX 4090, 24 GB: No, it asks for a 32 GB GPU
Terminal-Bench 4.0 42.3: Command-line tasks; Opus 5 scores 51.8, per DeepSeek
DeepSWE 77.0: Software-engineering tasks; Opus 5 scores 74.0, per DeepSeek
HLE 42.6: Hard exam questions without tools; Opus 5 scores 56.3, per DeepSeek
the_catch: These scores are DeepSeek's own. The hardware lines come from one community quant, which tops out at 16K context and is text-only.
caption: DeepSeek's model card gives no memory figures. The one community quant we read lists a 359.32 GB file and asks for a 32 GB GPU, 128 GB of RAM and 80 GiB free at launch. Save this for the next open model. What do you run models on?
alt_text: A cheat sheet asking whether DeepSeek V4.1 Flash runs on a phone, an 8 GB laptop, a 16 GB MacBook Air, an RTX 4060 and an RTX 4090. The answer for each is no. Below are three benchmark scores and the catch.
